sentences.text: Southpaw is a 2015 American sports drama film directed by Antoine Fuqua , written by Kurt Sutter and starring Jake Gyllenhaal , Forest Whitaker and Rachel McAdams .	Antoine Fuqua	Antoine Fuqua	Kurt Sutter	Kurt Sutter	Jake Gyllenhaal	Jake Gyllenhaal	Forest Whitaker	Forest Whitaker	Rachel McAdams	Rachel McAdams	sports drama	Sports film
The film follows a young boxer who sets out to get his life back on track after losing his wife in an accident and his young daughter to protective services .
The film was released on July 24 , 2015 , by The Weinstein Company .	The Weinstein Company	The Weinstein Company
The film marked one of the last films to be scored by James Horner , and one of three posthumous releases to feature his music .	James Horner	James Horner
The film and the film 's soundtrack album are dedicated to his memory .
